title: Both answers fall inside the 3% band around the expected value, so both pass
alt: A scale of average order value in BRL. A shaded band runs from 133.62 to 141.88, the 3% tolerance around the expected answer of 137.75. Two points sit inside it: 137.04 from the evaluation run and 137 from a chat answer the same afternoon. Both passed.
caption: The 3% tolerance around one expected answer. Evaluation run and a chat answer, 27 October 2026.
